meta.title: 궤도 일곱
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (궤도 일곱, a documentary trailer (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Space and light only: black #03050A, the atmosphere blue #6FA8FF and its dawn orange #FF9A4D (in the shader), city gold #E8B964 for the orbit and the one line about the sun, off-white #EEF2F8 for cards, grey-blue #AAB4C4 for the small print.
rationale.type: Trailer cards in Noto Serif KR SemiBold, letter-spaced and centred or set on the left; the title in Black Han Sans, huge and tracked in from wide, with a sweep of light across it.
rationale.motion: A trailer: long, slow camera moves with nothing hurried; cards fade in and out; the sun breaking the limb is the event of the opening, the boom on the title the event of the end. Scope bars (2.39:1) throughout.
rationale.sound: Cinematic-lite at 96 BPM in C minor (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s): low strings and pad, sparse; a swell into the sunrise, a boom and a shimmer on the title.
rationale.visuals: All code: the Earth is a WebGL2 shader (an analytic sphere with fbm continents and clouds, sun glint, city lights on the night side, a 12-sample scattering shell); the station is flat-shaded 3D (tiny3d) lit by the same sun; the flare (starburst, anamorphic streak, ghosts), the orbit line and the cards are 2D.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the cards are the voice of a trailer.
